details:
bundle-entry-points has no functional code, and its description ("A utility for managing SVG buckets.") does not match its name. Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50`, revealing to the collector that the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account djdhhdjdjf7777, which has no other packages; the same code, with a different webhook.site URL, was published as com.unity.external-dependency-manager by the account depipp777 on 2026-11-22.

## Source: amazon-inspector (4f9e3aa058b3b4761ee33eda964ae22924c94662e4c08ac6ee5e837330e34ed4)
The package declares a postinstall script that runs index.js on npm install. index.js issues a POST request with a JSON body containing an event tag ('authorized-poc-test'), a random test identifier, and a status field to a hardcoded webhook.site URL (https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50). webhook.site is an anonymous request collector not associated with any legitimate package infrastructure. The script also reads the installer's hostname and current working directory, logging them locally. The package self-identifies as a proof-of-concept via [POC] log tags. Installing the package auto-executes outbound network contact to an anonymous third-party endpoint without consent, confirming successful install on the target host to the operator of the collector.

## Source: ghsa-malware (397d7c113ddac70940865bf85fba80b022e8ec8bcf2fbfeb9173f8f1821c2557)
Any computer that has this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. All secrets and keys stored on that computer should be rotated immediately from a different computer. The package should be removed, but as full control of the computer may have been given to an outside entity, there is no guarantee that removing the package will remove all malicious software resulting from installing it.
